fact: Capital reports Ethiopia's non-bank mobile-money operators and payment-service providers are preparing to integrate with PAPSS, each needing a National Bank of Ethiopia Letter of No Objection first.

FSX Business reports Ethiopia became the 31st PAPSS member country and four Ethiopian banks have begun the regulatory process to join, awaiting National Bank of Ethiopia no-objection letters, with no bank yet operational.
The National Digital Payment Strategy 2026-2030 proposes enabling low-value outbound cross-border transfers via cards, wallets and digital banking for the first time (FMC/ENA/Shega).
source_slug: 2025-12-09 Ethiopia launches National Digital Payments Strategy 2026-2030

fact: ITWeb Africa reports Ethiopia has joined PAPSS, enabling financial institutions across the country to connect and take part in instant cross-border payments with counterparts across Africa.
Afreximbank's release says Ethiopia has officially joined the PAPSS network, enabling Ethiopian financial institutions to connect and make cross-border payments with institutions across Africa.
